senses.gloss: (Saf. of רהב; cmp. סָרַב) [to be imperious,] to order, urge, press.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 32b:23">B. Kam. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>כשרבו מְסַרְהֵב בו לצאת</he> (Ms. M. <he>מְסָרֵב</he>) when his master (the smith) had strictly ordered him to leave the smithy.
<cite ref="Chullin 94a:10">Ḥull. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>אל יְסַרְהֵב אדם בחבירו</he> (not <he>לחבירו</he>), v. <cite ref="O01511"><he>סָרַב</he></cite>.
